newsitem.title: UK: Iran, Indonesia popular in sugar freight inquiry.
newsitem.headline: Iran, Indonesia popular in sugar freight inquiry.

text.p: Iran and Indonesia again featured as quoted end-destinations on the sugar freight market as various new orders emerged but few fixtures, shipbrokers said on Wednesday.

But demand from South American origins, including key shipper Brazil, was quiet, they said. Glencore was in the market for 12/13,500 tonnes of bagged sugar from Thailand to Indonesia for 24 February/5 March.
Czarnikow Rionda was in the market for 9/11,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Corinto to US Gulf/Atlantic for 10/20 February.
E D & F Man quoted for 12,000 tonnes in bags from the EU to Iran for prompt/10 days notice and was said to have fixed its earlier order for around 7,000 tonnes from Gijon to Syria.
Shipbrokers said Genoc was open for 14,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Cuba to Klaipeda with Med/Black Sea options for spot/5 February, possibly as a replacement for an earlier inquiry.
